item.description: The Ministry of Labour and Manpower Planning has successfully facilitated the signing of a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA), constituting a Collective Labour Agreement, between the Mayor and Councillors of the City of Georgetown (M&CC) and the Guyana Labour Union (GLU).
